intended_use.summary: Assess a conditional HyP3 Basic GAMMA RTC route for the four exact frozen ascending Sentinel-1D GRDs, with local integrity and pixel QA and, only on QA pass, an ArcGIS before/after visual panel. No baseline, change analysis, attribution, or derived-pixel publication.
planned_actions: conditional four-job RTC acquisition for local QA

sources.name: ASF HyP3 Basic full-scene GAMMA RTC from M1-SRC-002, M1-SRC-005, M1-SRC-001, and M1-SRC-004

evidence.note: Four exact scene names and GAMMA job shapes are bound offline to the saved official API schema and ASF catalog rows.
ASF public catalog supplied the adjacent two exact GRD rows.

criteria.note: This identifies the proposed input cohort and service, not future generated product IDs or bytes.

evidence.note: ASF's official HyP3 documentation identifies the Basic service and its Sentinel-1 on-demand workflows.
Official guide identifies full-scene GAMMA RTC output and method options.

criteria.note: ASF is the direct processing provider and authoritative source for service behavior, not proof of this cohort's product fitness.

evidence.note: Basic uses Earthdata Login, documents free monthly credits and 14-day output retention.
Official table documents the nominal per-job 10 m RTC credit cost.
Owner reports successful Vertex sign-in; the agent did not inspect the account.

criteria.note: Current account credit balance, exact S1D eligibility, possible restrictions, and accepted job cost must be verified without submission before any job. No paid purchase is permitted.

evidence.note: ASF says job metadata and generated products are public.
ASF asks users to include each product's acknowledgement in publications and presentations.
Owner attests to accepting an agreement at sign-in, but its exact document and version were not captured.

criteria.note: The exact accepted agreement and derived-output redistribution terms have not been verified. Local QA and eventual map export must remain conditional; raw or derived pixel publication is excluded.

evidence.note: Candidate binds the existing M1 source IDs to exact GRD names, method settings, order, and saved OpenAPI schema.
Separate provider provenance and local no-replace custody are required; local AUX_RESORB application is not claimed.

criteria.note: Future job and product IDs, actual orbit/DEM versions, README, and processing logs must be retained after generation.

evidence.note: Conditional plan requires exact job settings and IDs, non-Git append-only custody, hashes, container verification, and no-replace promotion.

criteria.note: Post-acquisition integrity plan supports consideration of a bounded acquisition; no product bytes or integrity pass exist yet.

evidence.note: Four catalog footprints meet the frozen 99% geometry screen as a date-pair union, not valid raster coverage.
Frozen 99% valid coverage, 80% usable AOI, EPSG:32645 grid and registration checks remain prerequisites.

criteria.note: Fit only for an attempt to establish product and pixel fitness; it is not evidence of usable radar pixels, admission, or observed change.

evidence.note: Owner accepts public job metadata and outputs; no identity or secret is recorded.
Project rules keep credentials, source archives, rasters and packages outside Git.

criteria.note: A separate Earthdata secret-safe handoff and synthetic leak tests have not been implemented; no token, account access, or job action is permitted yet.

blocking_reasons: Current account capacity and exact S1D job eligibility unknown
Exact accepted terms and output rights not captured or assessed
Earthdata secret-safe handoff not implemented or tested
No method or job authority approved

claim_boundary: This assessment does not authorize account access or processing. It permits a conditional review packet that stops before any job unless every unresolved access, rights, privacy, integrity, and public-CI gate passes.
